artifact: macOS Xbox GIP runtime integration proof

pre_fix_observations.config_root_cause: RuntimeConfig parsed controller modes but not packaged p1_device/p2_device, so Release retained its keyboard default
pre_fix_observations.hardened_runtime_regression: After directly opening GIP in a hardened test, macOS terminated the process with SIGKILL (Code Signature Invalid)
pre_fix_observations.hardened_runtime_fault: libusb_interrupt_transfer reached static GIP packet bytes in signed __TEXT,__const after the page was dirtied through a const_cast OUT buffer
pre_fix_observations.signing_verification_gap: Studio reported success while its temporary certificate keychain still existed; the delivered app later failed independent codesign verification.

fixes.change: top-level controller defaults are parsed, including configs without a runtime block
game.toml device defaults are applied before per-install settings.toml overrides
every synchronous USB OUT transfer uses owned writable storage
removes the temporary signing keychain before the final delivered-app verification
removes its temporary signing keychain before final app/DMG verification

verification.full_framework_runtime_link: not applicable to this checkout because generated/SCPH1001_full.c is absent; Studio exports supply generated BIOS/game sources

delivery_requirement: Existing exported apps contain the old runtime and must be re-exported after this fix.
